## Biography

The Sea of Dreams. A region below the galactic plane, approximately a thousand light years down — far enough that the familiar spiral arms become abstract curves, close enough that the Milky Way still dominates the sky.

Rainbow's End was constructed here during the Distant Worlds 3 expedition. The location was chosen for its isolation: no major trade routes, no established settlements, no reason for any government to pay attention. Deep Space Surveys built the station to house experimental inhibitor technology derived from Guardian and Quirium research, technology designed to study and potentially contain witch-space anomalies. The Mare Somnia region offered privacy. It also offered proximity to whatever the DW3 expedition had been tracking — the pulse, the cadence, the thing that looked through Jasmina Halsey in the hyperspace corridor and recoiled from a pressure it did not understand.

Some seas are deeper than others. This one dreams in frequencies.
